items.question: What is Chained Beasts?
items.answer: A one-to-four-player co-op gladiator roguelike by Featherweight Games. Fight in arenas, use chains and environmental hazards, and manage injuries between battles.

items.question: Can you play solo?
items.answer: Yes. The official Steam listing includes single-player as well as online and local co-op.

items.question: Which platforms are announced?
items.answer: Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch, with Game Pass for Xbox and Windows PC announced for launch.

items.question: Is this the official wiki?
items.answer: No. This is an independent fan resource. Featherweight Games owns the game and its artwork.

about.title: What is Chained Beasts?
paragraphs: Chained Beasts is a co-op gladiator roguelike from Featherweight Games for one to four players. Your party fights through arena battles while chained together, so every dodge, throw and retreat also moves the people attached to you. The developer describes synchronized teams tripping enemies with the chain, while uncoordinated teams get tangled around pillars.

Weapons are only part of the fight. The developer highlights thrown weapons, thrown objects, arena hazards and crowd approval, and recovery between rounds comes with a price: healing can add afflictions that affect movement, perception or decisions. The launch overview announces more than seventy skills, over forty items, eight unlockable beasts with variants, three acts and ten difficulty levels.

The game launched on October 15, 2026, on Steam (Windows and macOS), PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S with Game Pass, and Nintendo Switch, with online cross-play advertised at launch. Featherweight Games has also published a roadmap that targets Update 1.1 in December 2026 and a desired PvP mode in early 2027.

This wiki is an independent player resource, not the official site. Every guide separates what Featherweight Games and the platform stores have confirmed from our own suggestions, links its sources, and records when it was last checked, so you can tell launch facts apart from old Demo details.

steps.title: Check your controls first
steps.text: Steam recommends a gamepad, and same-screen co-op needs at least one. Confirm your bindings in the installed version before the first arena.

steps.title: Learn how the chain moves you
steps.text: Agree on a direction with your party and make short movement calls. A clear route for one fighter can drag another into a hazard.

steps.title: Fight for position, not just damage
steps.text: Thrown weapons, objects and arena hazards all hurt enemies. Keep a replacement weapon and an exit route in mind before you commit.

steps.title: Read the price of every heal
steps.text: Recovery between rounds can add afflictions. Judge a heal by how well you can handle the next fight, not by the health bar alone.

items.question: Does Chained Beasts have split screen?
items.answer: Chained Beasts has local couch co-op for up to four players on one system, but no official source confirms a split-screen view: the developer calls it same-screen co-op, and Steam requires at least one gamepad. Steam also lists Remote Play Together for friends playing over the internet.

items.question: Is Chained Beasts cross-platform?
items.answer: Yes. The developer advertises online cross-play for up to four players, and Steam lists cross-platform multiplayer. In launch gameplay the online lobby has a Crossplay checkbox; the sources do not yet document every platform pairing.

items.question: Is Chained Beasts on Game Pass?
items.answer: Yes. Xbox announced Chained Beasts for Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass on cloud, Xbox Series X|S and PC at launch.

items.question: What are the Chained Beasts PC system requirements?
items.answer: The official Windows minimum is 64-bit Windows 10, an Intel Core i5-5257U or AMD Ryzen 3 1200, 8 GB RAM and a GTX 1050 or Radeon RX 460. No detailed recommended specification was published.

items.question: How much does Chained Beasts cost?
items.answer: Featherweight Games announced a regular US price of $19.99 and a $12.99 launch offer for two weeks. Regional prices and taxes vary by store.

items.question: Will Chained Beasts get new content after launch?
items.answer: The developer roadmap targets Update 1.1 in December 2026 with a new arena, boss, weapon and enemies, followed by a desired PvP mode in Q1 2027. These are plans, not released features.
